property_summary: For any depositor, calling withdrawAll either reverts on a failing external transfer (reference) or leaves the contract state inconsistent when the external transfer fails (mutant); specifically, the reference always reverts when the callee reverts during the low-level call from withdrawAll, but the mutant does not—so there exists a caller/deposit amount and a callee that reverts on receive() which makes the mutant leave balance and credit inconsistent while the reference reverts.
change_summary: Delete the require on the call result so a failed transfer no longer reverts (observable when transfers fail).
